### Emera Teleconference on November 6 to Discuss Q3 2026 Results and 2027-2031 Capital Plan


October 9, 2026


HALIFAX, Nova Scotia--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Today Emera (TSX/NYSE: EMA) announced that it will release its **** Q3 2026 results and outline its 5-year capital and funding plan on Friday, November 6, 2026, before markets open. The Company will host a teleconference and webcast the same day at 9:30 a.m. Atlantic (8:30 a.m. Eastern) to discuss the results.


Analysts and other interested parties in North America are invited to participate by dialing 1-800-717-1738. International parties are invited to participate by dialing 1-289-514-5100. Participants should dial in at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the call. No pass code is required.


A live and archived audio webcast of the teleconference will be available on the Company's website,[www.emera.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.emera.com%2Fevents-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54618739&newsitemid=20261009696208&lan=en-US&anchor=www.emera.com&index=1&md5=fb040f4e8857264f6286f38ba0d61134) . A replay of the teleconference will be available on the Company’s website two hours after the conclusion of the call.

**About Emera Inc.**


Emera (TSX/NYSE: EMA) is a leading North American provider of energy services headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia, with investments in regulated electric and natural gas utilities, and related businesses and assets. The Emera family of companies delivers safe, reliable energy to approximately 2.1 million customers in the United States, Canada and the Caribbean. Our team of 6,800 employees is committed to our purpose of energizing modern life and delivering a cleaner energy future for all. Emera’s common and preferred shares are listed and trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange and its common shares are listed and trade on the New York Stock Exchange. Additional information can be accessed at[www.emera.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.emera.com%2F&esheet=54618739&newsitemid=20261009696208&lan=en-US&anchor=www.emera.com&index=4&md5=f96da0e3aa30fcbc6e016efc60971b3d) , on SEDAR+ at[www.sedarplus.ca](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sedarplus.ca&esheet=54618739&newsitemid=20261009696208&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sedarplus.ca&index=5&md5=0d73df7e20a8d32974eb6d41fceaa677) and on EDGAR at[www.sec.gov](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcan01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Furldefense.com%252Fv3%252F__http%253A%252Fwww.sec.gov__%253B%21%21P0w-YG-Y-g%21ZDmC-_z9ve-y0_CHwwJiSeGYMOf2QEJjHjJ_Wn2-LCYTZ_U-Yz_a3t91cPZ5UZJLR9C6BadeluX4HcL4%2524%26data%3D05%257C02%257CJohn.MacLean%2540emera.com%257C0eeca84a74c64d5aa11c08dd9d2d1300%257Cfd6bcd8158354f87b63374c802612d0f%257C0%257C0%257C638839539129446746%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3D3Gl4Lqal%252BArfuAJTZLUFMDReETC8VESWsnPJYaXkWLY%253D%26reserved%3D0&esheet=54618739&newsitemid=20261009696208&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov&index=6&md5=21a3f4f2a0ba0fb7bbe96fe64ee9c37a) .
